page.overview:
Who is Bob Belcher?

Robert "Bob" Belcher, Jr. is the main character of Bob's Burgers. He is the husband of Linda Belcher and the father of Tina, Gene, and Louise Belcher. He makes his first appearance in Season 25 episode "Homerland" during the closing credits.

If a picture of Bob Belcher displaying an offensive burger were to circulate, it could lead to some individuals boycotting the restaurant.

During the closing credits in "Homerland," Bob, Linda, and his children were in the Simpson House celebrating the 25th season.

After Peter shot down another plane with Homer, Bob boarded the plane.
